# OLD prop system in cart/hmsc-int — full map

## Orientation: the two retired sources

`cart/hmsc-int/game/kinds/props.ts:13-19` states the history explicitly: since **PROPMERGE-0611**, the legacy twin `world/propKinds.ts` was retired and this file became **THE ONE TABLE** that every consumer resolves through (editor palette, PropertiesPanel, placements, host physics, traffic, prop meshes, and `compile/worldGeometry`). Props came from **built-in TS recipe defs** (one file per prop under `compile/propRecipes/`) plus **editor-exported meshes** (two flavors: the `importPropMesh` CLI baker and the Studio "cook" pipeline). All of them normalize to the single `PropKindDefinition` type below.

---

## 1. The ONE prop table — `cart/hmsc-int/game/kinds/props.ts`

### Kind universe
- `BuiltinPropKind` — a union of ~430 string literals, `props.ts:464-937`.
- `PropKind = BuiltinPropKind | ImportedPropKind` — `props.ts:938`.
- Cooked (Studio) kinds are registered at **runtime** into `COOKED_PROP_DEFS` (`props.ts:1710`, `registerCookedProps` at `1715`), so `PropKind` doesn't statically list them.
- Category shelves: `PropCategory` (`props.ts:1662`) and `PROP_CATEGORIES` (`props.ts:1668`) — nature/trees/rocks/street/signs/furniture/household/media/commerce/junkyard/sport/park/shops/imported/studio.

### The prop-definition type — every field a prop can carry
`cart/hmsc-int/game/kinds/props.ts:960-1011`:

```ts
export type PropKindDefinition = {
  kind: PropKind;
  label: string;
  solid: boolean;                    // collides with player/vehicles
  footprintRadiusMeters: number;     // coarse collision/concealment radius
  footprintWidthMeters?: number;     // yaw-aware rectangle (non-square props)
  footprintDepthMeters?: number;
  heightMeters: number;              // visual top, 1 tile = 1 meter
  tileKind: TileKind;                // BORROWS gameplay bundle from a tile kind
  trafficControl: PropTrafficControl;
  dynamics?: PropDynamics;           // KICKPROP: dynamic sphere body (kickable)
  collisionBoxes?: PropCollisionBox[]; // SHAPE-AWARE per-component collision (req_1587)
  mount?: PropMount;                 // floor | surface | wall placement
  seat?: PropSeat;                   // sit/lay anchor(s)
  container?: PropContainer;         // searchable / lock-key loot
  coverClass?: PropCoverClass;       // none | soft | hard (stealth/combat)
  buildPlacement?: PropBuildPlacement; // places as a build piece (snap/cover/pieceKind/portal)
  doorPanel?: PropDoorPanel;         // functional two-state door leaf
};
```

Note there is **no `text` field on the kind** — signage text is per-*instance* (see §2, `WorldProp.text`); the kind's recipe decides what the string means.

The gameplay-capability sub-types (`props.ts`):

**Collision (shape-aware):** `PropCollisionBox` — `955-958` (one AABB per connected mesh component; `minY` above head = walk-under).

**Dynamics (kickable):** `PropDynamics` — `1064-1069` (`bodyRadiusMeters`, `restitution` 0..1). Helper `propDynamics()` at `1072`.

**Mount / placement class:** `PropMount = 'floor' | 'surface' | 'wall'` — `1088`. Helper `propMount()` `1140`.

**Seats / grips / placements (the sit + pin system):** `PropSeat` — `1092-1111`:
```ts
export type PropSeat = {
  pose: 'sit' | 'lay';
  seatHeightMeters: number;       // pelvis height above ground anchor
  capacity: number;               // chair 1, couch/bench 3, double bed 2
  pin?: { x: number; z: number; faceDeg: number };   // single seat pin (req_1930)
  pins?: { x: number; z: number; faceDeg: number }[]; // multi-seat (booth bench, req_2028-2030)
};
```
`DEFAULT_SEAT_PIN` at `1115`; resolvers `propSeat()` `1144`, `propSeatPin()` `1150`, `propSeatPins()` `1158`.

**Searchable slots / lock-key (containers):** `props.ts:1117-1133`:
```ts
export type PropLootCategory = 'junk'|'kitchen'|'bathroom'|'clothing'|'office'|'valuables'|'tools';
export type PropContainerAccess = 'open' | 'locked' | 'keyed';  // 'keyed' = needs its key
export type PropContainer = {
  lootCategory: PropLootCategory;
  capacity: number;               // item slots
  spawnFillChance: number;        // 0..1 per slot
  searchSeconds: number;          // the search loading bar
  access: PropContainerAccess;
};
```
Helper `propContainer()` `1164`. The design note at `1076-1084` calls this "the user's taxonomy, as data" and states **items are not built yet** — `lootCategory` names the slot the item system will fill; the schema is authored now so containers don't need a second pass.

**Cover (stealth/combat):** `PropCoverClass = 'none' | 'soft' | 'hard'` — `1138`. `propCoverClass()` `1170-1176` derives from tileKind/solid/height when unauthored (bush→soft, solid ≥0.9m→hard).

**Build-piece behavior (railings/trim/doorways):** `PropBuildPlacement` — `1017-1035` (`snap`, `cover`, `blocksSight`, `pieceKind`, `portal`).

**Doors (two-state):** `PropDoorPanel` — `1043-1061` (leaf center/extents in meters, `reachMeters`, `vehicle`, and `meshStart`/`meshCount` sub-range in the cooked blob; compiles into the DOORS lump, same two-state machine as a built-in WallEdit door).

**Resolver:** `propKindDefinition(kind)` `1743` — merges `PROP_KIND_DEFINITIONS` (`1178`, built-ins), `IMPORTED_PROP_DEFINITIONS`, and `COOKED_PROP_DEFS`; `COOKED_PROP_FALLBACK` at `1751`.

### Representative entries (diverse capability fields)

**`safe` — keyed searchable container + hard cover** (`compile/propRecipes/safe.ts:11-22`):
```ts
export const safeDef: PropKindDefinition = {
  kind: 'safe', label: 'Safe', solid: true,
  footprintRadiusMeters: 0.4, heightMeters: 0.55,
  tileKind: 'wall', trafficControl: 'none',
  container: { lootCategory: 'valuables', capacity: 4, spawnFillChance: 0.6, searchSeconds: 5, access: 'keyed' },
  coverClass: 'hard',
};
```

**`vendingMachine` — locked container** (`compile/propRecipes/vendingMachine.ts:11-20`): `container: { lootCategory: 'kitchen', capacity: 3, spawnFillChance: 0.5, searchSeconds: 3, access: 'locked' }, coverClass: 'hard'`.

**`sofa` — 3-seat sit anchor + soft cover** (`compile/propRecipes/sofa.ts:11-22`):
```ts
seat: { pose: 'sit', seatHeightMeters: 0.42, capacity: 3 }, coverClass: 'soft',
```

**`dinerBooth` — 2-seat** (`compile/propRecipes/dinerBooth.ts:22-31`): `seat: { pose: 'sit', seatHeightMeters: 0.45, capacity: 2 }`.

**`fountain` — seat + water geometry** (`compile/propRecipes/fountain.ts:6-30`): `seat: { pose:'sit', seatHeightMeters:0.55, capacity:3 }`; water is expressed as mesh parts (cylinders/spheres tinted `#3a8fd8`), not a capability flag.

**`streetLight` / `streetSign` — signage/light with NO gameplay bundle** (`compile/propRecipes/streetLight.ts:10-20`, `streetSign.ts:11-22`): plain `solid/footprint/height/tileKind/trafficControl` only. The sign's printed text is a per-instance `WorldProp.text` lowered by the recipe (`streetSign` panel geometry at `streetSign.ts:34-40`). Light is baked as an emissive mesh part (`warmGlass`) — there is no `light` capability field on the kind (authored lights live on the Studio mesh instead; see §3 `LightRig`).

---

## 2. Placement → world — `placements.ts`, `mapBuildPlacements.ts`, `editorWorld.ts`

### The editor-side placement record — `cart/hmsc-int/placements.ts:21-54`
```ts
export interface Placement {
  id: string;
  cat: PlaceCat;            // 'building' | 'prop' | 'marker' | 'water'  (line 19)
  kind: string;
  label: string;
  gx: number; gy: number;  // canvas graph position (node CENTER); TILE_UNITS per meter
  rotation: number;        // degrees
  locked: boolean;
  footW: number; footD: number;  // footprint tiles (resolved from the kind registry)
  color: string;           // top-down swatch
  skin?: Building['skin'];         // per-face building texture
  partTextures?: Record<string, string>;  // per-PART re-skin (buildings AND props)
  spawnId?: string;        // save↔spawn marker link
  text?: string;           // per-instance parametric text → WorldProp.text on compile (line 45-47)
  gen?: string;            // derived-from-road-network id (intersections, line 48-53)
}
```
- Footprint/label/color resolve from the kind registries via `resolvePlaceable()` `95-114` (props at `110-113` borrow the kind's `footprintWidth/DepthMeters` and tile color).
- Graph↔world cell math: `placementCellRect()` `70-83`, `worldToPlacementGraph()` `89-91`. `mapStore.ts:246,376` shows the persistence round-trip carrying `text`/`spawnId`/`gen`.

### Buildings are a separate stream — `cart/hmsc-int/mapBuildPlacements.ts`
Props/markers/water live in the place layer's payload, but **buildings** are the game/build semantic stream; this file is the bridge. `MapBuildPlaceable` (`12-20`), `MapBuildFootprint` (`22-31`), graph↔world (`graphToBuildWorld` `35`, `buildWorldToGraph` `43`), palette footprint via `mapBuildPlaceable()` (`66-78`), and connectivity-grouped footprints `mapBuildFootprints()` (`88-118`, WeakMap-cached on the pieces array identity, PLACEPERF-0610).

### The compiled world prop — `cart/hmsc-int/design.ts:448-466`
```ts
export type WorldProp = {
  id: string;
  kind: PropKind;
  x: number; y: number; z: number;
  yawDegrees: number;
  signalOverride?: TrafficSignalPhase;
  partTextures?: Record<string, string>;  // per-part re-skin (street sign panel/pole, etc.)
  text?: string;                          // PARAMETRIC per-instance text (req_0893)
  createdByCommand: string;
};
```
Placement authoring: `editorWorld.ts:106-125` `placeWorldProp()` builds the `WorldProp` — grounds `y` on the terrain (`landformGroundTopAt`, line 115) and lowers `partTextures`/`text` conditionally. `world/props.ts` is the world-layer geometry/query/footprint twin (`PropFootprint` `props.ts:10`, yaw-aware rects for long-thin props, FOOTPRINT-0756).

### Compile flow
`packageMap.ts` writes props into the **PLACEMENTS** lump (`200-201`, `334`) and lowers them across layers: `INTERACTABLES` (`360`), `DYNAMIC_PROPS` (`363`), imported OBJ/GLB props (`379`). `compile/worldGeometry.ts:972-982` shows build-piece props materializing as `WorldProp`s carrying `partTextures` (`979`) and `text` (`982`). `text` is consumed by `compile/propRecipes/resolve.ts:468` `resolvePropParts(prop)` (the kind decides what the string means — block letters, neon caption, LED ticker).

---

## 3. Editor-exported-mesh prop path

There are **two** export paths, both normalizing to `PropKindDefinition`.

### (a) `importPropMesh` CLI baker — `cart/hmsc-int/tools/importPropMesh.mjs`
Bakes an OBJ/GLB into the registry (header `1-9`, usage `16-28`). Options: `--kind --label --height --footprint[-width/-depth] --color --solid --cover`. Writes `game/kinds/importedProps.data.json` and regenerates `importedProps.generated.ts` (`85-87`). **A minimal capability set** — the imported def carries no seat/container/door/mount/text:

`cart/hmsc-int/game/kinds/importedProps.generated.ts:7-31`:
```ts
export type ImportedPropDefinition = {
  kind: ImportedPropKind; label: string; solid: boolean;
  footprintRadiusMeters: number; footprintWidthMeters?: number; footprintDepthMeters?: number;
  heightMeters: number; tileKind: 'wall'; trafficControl: 'none';
  coverClass: 'hard' | 'soft' | 'none';
};
export type ImportedPropMesh = {
  key: string; source: string; color: [number,number,number]; count: number;
  boundsRadius: number; footprintWidthMeters: number; footprintDepthMeters: number;
  heightMeters: number; solid: boolean; vertices: Float32Array;  // 8 floats/vertex
};
```
Two shipped examples (`imported.desk`, `imported.hydrant`) at `33-58`; meshes at `60+` (raw `Float32Array` vertex soup). At compile these become static prop vertex buffers (`worldGeometry.ts:274` `collectImportedMeshProp`).

### (b) Studio "cook" — the richer editor-exported package — `cart/hmsc-int/editors/model/cookedAsset.ts`
This is the export format that carries **all** plausible capabilities. Design law at `cookedAsset.ts:11-23`: geometry/texture are **factored** (content-addressed blobs shared across assets), the descriptor is flat declarative data (**never per-asset code**), and measured fields (footprint/height/collision/seat pins/door leaf) are **derived from the mesh**, not hand-typed.

Key types (`cookedAsset.ts`):
- `COOK_SCHEMA = 2` (`38`, hard-validated), `CookKind = 'prop'|'item'|'vehiclePart'|'vehicle'|'clothing'` (`40`).
- `MeshBlob` (`62-84`) — 8-float/vertex soup + re-skinnable `slots` + trailing sub-ranges for `glass`, door `leaf`, and `leafGlass` (req_1673/1864/2020). `CookedTextureSlot` `91-99`.
- `CookCollision` (`104-116`) — measured footprints + shape-aware `boxes: PropCollisionBox[]` (archway → 3 boxes, walk-under).
- **`PropDescriptorInput`** (`118-145`) — the authoring surface, "`PropKindDefinition` minus the measured fields": `label, solid, tileKind, trafficControl, physics{restitution}, mount, seat, container, coverClass, buildPlacement, door{vehicle}`. Seats/containers/cover/doors are all authorable here.
- **`CookedAsset`** (`149-176`) — the exported package: `id, hash, kind, name, schema, meshRef, texRef?, collision, mounts: MountPoint[], slots?, glass?, leaf?, leafGlass?, descriptor: PropKindDefinition`.
- `CookResult` (`178-184`) — `{ asset, blob, errors }`; the cook **aborts** on non-empty errors.
- Validation `validateProp()` (`459-482`) enumerates the **load-bearing required fields** per capability (container needs capacity/access/lootCategory/searchSeconds; seat needs pose/capacity/seatHeightMeters; dynamics needs radius/restitution 0..1). Validator table `cookValidators` `485-492` (only `prop` implemented; item/vehicle/clothing stubbed).
- Seat pins are derived from a face-rig: `deriveSeatFromFaces`/`RiggedFace`/`SeatRigFace` imported at `cookedAsset.ts:34` from `game/figure/seating`.

**Grips / anchors / lights / mounts** ride the Studio mesh (`editors/model/editMesh.ts`):
- `MountPoint` (`editMesh.ts:66-95`) — `kind: 'socket'|'plug'|'anchor'`; an `anchor` (req_1244) is a fixed placement (seat/cargo/grip) with `role: 'driver'|'passenger'|'cargo'|'mount'` (`ANCHOR_ROLES` `55`) and `axis` as facing. Joints carry rotation `limit`.
- `LightRig` (`editMesh.ts:133-149`) — authored per-part lights (`point`/`spot`, position/dir/color/intensity/range/spread) — this is how a prop carries **light** (signage glow, lamps), part-local so it rides the placed prop.
- `EditMesh.slots` (TextureSlot, `117-123`) — re-skinnable face groups → cooked `CookedTextureSlot` → `WorldProp.partTextures`.

**Install/registration:** `editors/model/cookedAssets.ts` — `installCookedAsset()` (`62`), `syncCookedRegistry()` (`30-35`) calls `registerCookedProps` (props.ts) + `registerCookedCatalog` + `registerCookedAssetLookup`. `cookedPropSurfaceYs()` (`90`) exposes **tabletop surface heights** for placing objects on a cooked prop's top faces.

### PropBrowser — `cart/hmsc-int/PropBrowser.tsx`
The palette (req_1895). Picture grid, tag-search-driven (`searchProps`/`PropEntry` from `game/kinds/propTags`, line 15), favorites (`16`), auto-framed 3D thumbs from each prop's own measured `propVisualBounds` (`36-44`). It lists the whole catalog including **cooked props** (`92-96`, re-renders on cooked install via `useCookedAssets()`); built objects come from `buildObjectWorld('prop', kind)` (`54`).

---

## 4. Capability pins & gates — DESIGN-ONLY (`docs/game/SKELETON_OBJECT_MODEL.md`)

This is the design doc that generalizes prop capabilities into a bone/contact model. It explicitly names "**the prop pins/gates design**":
- `SKELETON_OBJECT_MODEL.md:32` — "the prop pins/gates design (\"pose = contact pins off bones\")".
- `76-77` — "Contacts are **pins off bones** (the prop pins/gates ruling, generalized)".
- `105` — "**prop pins/gates** — `contacts` ARE the pins; this is that design generalized to" (props → the universal skeleton object model).
- Object-model surface: joints (`joint?: fixed|hinge|slide|pivot|spin` with axis/limits, `48-49`) and typed contacts (wheel/door/windshield/grip/barrel/magazine/sight/room-anchor/**seat**, `73`) — a door hinges, a grip is a hand-contact, a pelvis sits at a seat-anchor (`76-77`), vehicle door-mounts/seat-anchors (`16`), building door/window-mounts + room-anchors (`17`).

The **searchable-slot / lock-key** capability is documented as *data*, not a separate pins/gates spec: `docs/game/hmsc-int.md:1934-1936` describes the archetype row carrying "sit/lay pose + seat height, **search seconds, open/locked/keyed access, loot category** — the same registry data `game/kinds/props.ts` authors." The in-code design rationale is the `PropContainer`/`PropSeat` comment block at `props.ts:1076-1084` ("the user's taxonomy, as data"; items not built yet, schema authored now).

---

## 5. Runtime consumption of gameplay capabilities

The compiled game runs these as **DATA + a fixed engine system** (V28: never JS in the loop). Documented at `docs/game/hmsc-int.md:1927-1959` (PROPUSE-COMPILED, req_0624):

- **Interactables lump (id 16)** — writer `compile/worldInteractables.ts`. `InteractableArchetype` (`worldInteractables.ts:38-43`) = `{ kind, label, seat: PropSeat|null, container: PropContainer|null }`; `InteractableInstance` (`45-52`) = archetype index + x/y/z/yaw. `collectInteractables` (`62-79`) records a prop **only if** `propSeat()` or `propContainer()` is non-null — so **seat and container are the load-bearing gameplay fields**. Wire format `encodeInteractables` (`96+`): per-archetype flags (bit0 seat / bit1 container), `seatPose` (0 sit/1 lay), `access` (0 open/1 locked/2 keyed), `seatHeightMeters`, `searchSeconds`, `label`, `lootCategory` (`85-95`).
- **Engine** (`hmsc-int.md:1941-1946`): `world_loader.zig stepInteract` — reach 2.2m, nearest wins, E toggles; **search** = a loading bar (`searchSeconds`) that cancels past 0.35m with a session-local searched set and **locked denial**; **sit/lay** pins the player at the seat and skips the movement step until WASD/Space stands up (baked player clips CLIP 3/4).
- **HUD** (`1947-1955`): the loader natively draws the InteractOverlay (prompt pill / loading bar / notice).
- **Doors**: `PropDoorPanel` compiles into the DOORS lump via `compile/worldDoors.ts` and `compile/worldColliders.ts` (leaf excluded from the static collider; opening is walkable) — same two-state machine as built-in WallEdit doors (`game/build/edits.ts`); a closed leaf blocks body + sight, E within `reachMeters` toggles it.
- **Dynamics** (kickable): `DYNAMIC_PROPS` lump (id 17, `compile/worldDynamicProps.ts`) — sphere body radius/restitution; `pushPropGeometry` routes dynamics kinds out of the static buffer (`hmsc-int.md:1961-1974`).
- **Cover**: `propCoverClass()` feeds the coverFraction/exposure contracts in `game/chance.ts` and `game/perception.ts` (per the type comment at `props.ts:1135-1138`).
- **Signage text**: `WorldProp.text` → `resolvePropParts()` (`compile/propRecipes/resolve.ts:468`) → geometry/animated material at bake; plain scenery ignores it.

**Load-bearing fields summary:** `kind`, `solid`, `footprint*`, `heightMeters`, `tileKind` (always); `seat` + `container` (drive the INTERACTABLES lump and all E-interaction); `container.access` (locked/keyed gating); `doorPanel` (DOORS lump); `dynamics` (DYNAMIC_PROPS lump); `coverClass` (stealth/combat); `partTextures` + `text` (per-instance re-skin/parametric); `buildPlacement` (build-piece snap/cover/portal).</result>
